messages.subject: Prefill API harness source delivered; native UNRUN
messages.body: Delivered the real opt-in pr6_prefill_api executable and narrow validation-only CMake target against immutable base 7b1bd9b67d58f2d653a2184b93e5ddb83f7dcc32, with MD/JSON/patch in bench/results/2026-10-16-pr6-faithful-restore/prefill-api-harness-v1 and patch SHA256 723aea1e71ada8b8fec7c71fb0516a0984fbcc997002021cc5a615f0a86f47a1. Prefill needs no decoder constructor split, the harness uses real native loaders and null-doorbell resident session state with explicit native PLE/head controls and bounded final residual/logit evidence, and all198 historical inventory files plus prior artifacts remain unchanged. Main must independently review and own every configure/build/provider/SHA/tiny-model/long numerical-state gate because all execution remains UNRUN and SOURCE_ONLY_UNSAFE_TO_RUN, with no600, physical256K, RESTORE or full decode claim.

messages.subject: Round 905 report ready
messages.body: Completed read-only decision-support research and wrote the 1,417-word report at bench/results/2026-10-15-pr6-recovery-audit/research-round905-v1.txt (SHA256 052b2a490dc94c0c748698cf58f2afdfab2ba5441386e9ea66f75402f1813199). It finds the installed runtime matches its exact source tag, while Metrics Discovery and Metrics Library revisions lag the runtime manifest; the PTI context split alone is not a demonstrated cause. The pool-create cause remains unresolved; the next step is a bounded unprivileged reproduction that logs Metrics Library query and report-size statuses without permission changes.
